The rest of Nallastia recognizes me by the title of Margravine.|The Skull Queen, Quenelle, and her daughter, Princess Calvaria, reveal themselves to the Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Bultar Swan|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
'''Skull Queen''' was a title given to a tribal leader on [[Nallastia]]. She lived in an ancient [[Skull Queen's fortress|fortress]] on [[Mount Octan]].

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Quenelle]] was the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] Skull [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] in addition to being its ruling [[King/Legends|monarch]], the [[Margravine]].
